pagetitle: "Media & outreach — Mads Fuglsang Hove"
---

I spend a good deal of time communicating research beyond the journals — both my own
findings and small-scale descriptive analyses that are useful to the public and to
journalists. Since 2022 I have commented on digital platforms' role in society more than
**50 times** across Danish news media, on topics from online political microtargeting to
the influence of misinformation and AI-generated content.

::: {.note-box}
**Journalists:** I am happy to comment on political advertising and targeting,
misinformation and AI-generated content, social media platforms and democracy, and Danish
political communication. Reach me at [madshove@ps.au.dk](mailto:madshove@ps.au.dk).
:::
